'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Spice Mine Operations]]
* '''Username:''' mryellow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
